The plates of above alloy components were prepared by vacuum arc melting.
They were first homogenized at 1200 °C for 2 h.
Then, cold rolled until the thickness was reduced by 80% and annealed at 900 °C for 0.5 h, 1 h, and 1.5 h, respectively

phases_and_microstructures.name: FCC
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 1.5 h

evidence.quote: the volume fractions of the matrix and L12 phases takes values of 81.2% and 18.8%, respectively

attributes.size: 20-500 nm in RZ (average 274.7 nm); average 43.8 nm in NRZ

evidence.quote: Elemental concentrations in the matrix and L12 phases of RA1.5 alloy.

phases_and_microstructures.name: L12
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 0.5 h

attributes.size: average 263.0 nm in RZ; average 28.7 nm in NRZ

evidence.quote: In RZ and NRZ, the average size are about 263.0 nm and 28.7 nm, respectively, as shown in Fig. 3.

phases_and_microstructures.name: L21 Heusler phase
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 1.5 h

evidence.quote: the formation of L21-type Heusler phase at grain boundaries was found, but its distribution was so few that it could be ignored

phases_and_microstructures.name: recrystallized zone (RZ)
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 1.5 h

evidence.quote: The RA1.5 alloy exhibits a heterostructure including recrystallized zone (RZ) with an average grain size of 1.45 µm and non-recrystallized zone (NRZ) with grain size of 10-100 µm

phases_and_microstructures.name: non-recrystallized zone (NRZ)
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 1.5 h

evidence.quote: non-recrystallized zone (NRZ) with grain size of 10-100 µm ... The volume fractions of these two parts are 37.4% and 62.6%, respectively.

phases_and_microstructures.name: recrystallized zone (RZ)
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 0.5 h

evidence.quote: for RA0.5 alloy, the volume fraction of RZ is about 8.8% and the grain size in RZ is about 2-10 µm.

phases_and_microstructures.name: annealing twin
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 1.5 h

evidence.quote: not only some annealing twins but also a few of micro-twins with multiple atomic plane scales are detected

phases_and_microstructures.name: micro-twin
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 1.5 h

evidence.quote: a few of micro-twins with multiple atomic plane scales are detected

phases_and_microstructures.name: dislocation cell structure
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 1.5 h

evidence.quote: A large number of dislocations aggregated around particles, forming a continuous dislocation cell structure

phases_and_microstructures.name: stacking fault
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 1.5 h

evidence.quote: The appearance of parallel SFs can be seen, which confirms the low SFE

phases_and_microstructures.name: stacking fault
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 0.5 h, tested at 293 K

evidence.quote: The average spacing between SFs is about 22.7 nm at 293 K, while the spacing is reduced by half to 10.3 nm at 77 K

phases_and_microstructures.name: Lomer-Cottrell lock
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: cold rolled and annealed at 900 °C for 0.5 h, tested

evidence.quote: after deformation, the SFs on different slip planes intersect and interact violently to form L-C locks
